```sql
WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
filtered_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id,
           ol.variant_id::uuid AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN filtered_orders fo ON fo.id = ol.order_id
),
per_product AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           count(DISTINCT fl.order_id) AS order_count,
           sum(fl.quantity)            AS quantity,
           sum(fl.line_total_cents)    AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT pv.id)       AS variant_count
      FROM filtered_lines fl
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = fl.variant_id
     GROUP BY pv.product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       pp.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN products p ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De orderfilter wordt eerst apart uitgevoerd, zodat de join met order_lines en de aggregatie op de kleinst mogelijke set rijen werken. Aggregeren gebeurt op product_id vóór de join met products, waardoor de dure GROUP BY op vijf kolommen vervalt. Het resultaat blijft gelijk, al is de volgorde bij gelijke quantity/revenue net als in het origineel niet gedefinieerd.
